items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions hearing Cleo Laine and clarifying she went to Ronny Scott's, not Johnny Dankworth's, implying no direct professional or personal interaction with Johnny Dankworth himself.

ctx.x: Yeah. Do you know we're nearly through this tape? So let's see now. I think I still have a couple of minutes to go on this. So, did you ever hear Cleo Laine, Johnny Dankworth's wife?
I'm trying to think. The first time I heard Cleo Laine was in London.
